title: Ponytail comments are genuinely useful engineering documentation
description: Throughout the codebase (grep -c 'ponytail:' src/*.rs shows ~20 instances). Each ponytail comment names the specific simplification, states the known ceiling (e.g. 'O(n) scan is fine for single-digit passkey count'), and describes the upgrade path. These are not TODOs — they are architectural decision records inline at the decision site. This is the right way to document intentional technical debt.
